kxrke01.title: Who takes being left on read the hardest
kxrke01.caption:
One read receipt, twelve completely different breakdowns. Pisces wrote a poem about it.
Stay for the twist at the end. Where are you on the board?

kxrke02.title: Who asks “what are we?” first
kxrke02.caption:
Somebody has to ask “so what are we?” Aries asked at the door on date one.
Who in your life would schedule the talk for Q1?

kxrke03.title: Who gives great advice and never takes it
kxrke03.caption:
The group chat's best advice-giver, live: says “rest!” and colour-codes the rest.
Which advice do you give everyone but yourself?
